title: SMOG Index Calculator
description: Compute the real SMOG readability grade from polysyllable density — designed for health and technical writing.
howto: Paste at least 30 sentences for a reliable SMOG score (10+ gives an estimate).
Words with 3+ syllables are counted automatically.
Read the SMOG grade: years of education needed to fully understand the text.

faqs.a: Simple Measure of Gobbledygook — created by G. Harry McLaughlin in 1969. It is widely used for healthcare and consumer-safety documents.
SMOG = 1.043 × √(polysyllables × 30 / sentences) + 3.1291, where polysyllables are words of 3 or more syllables.
The formula is calibrated for a 30-sentence sample. With fewer sentences the result is an approximation, which this tool labels honestly.
